stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 10 hours and pipe B can fill it in 8 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the cistern? (2 decimal places, in hours.)
solutionMarkdown: A's rate $= 1/10$ of the cistern per hour, B's rate $= 1/8$. Combined rate $= 1/10 + 1/8 = 0.2250$ per hour. Time together $= \dfrac{1}{1/10+1/8} = 4.44$ hours.
